run_note: Run covering 2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-10, executed 09:15 UTC Monday, US pre-market. Eight books still carry their 2026-08-07 closes because there has been no equity session since; crypto is the only live book. NO SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT and no R1 breach: all 13 new fills verified clean on both price-range and timing. THE FINDING THIS RUN IS A ROOT CAUSE, NOT A SYMPTOM, AND IT IS TWO SEPARATE FAULTS. (1) THE 6-HOUR BLACKOUTS ARE NOT CRON THROTTLING. Three blackouts of 363.7, 363.1 and 362.5 minutes in 30 hours, plus the 362-minute one logged on 08-08: four events all within 2 minutes of each other in length is a mechanism, not GitHub randomness. I read the workflow logs. Every other ~5h48m loop acquires the concurrency lock, hits 'CONFLICT (content)' on 15+ data/*.json files during its first 'git pull --rebase --autostash' about 50 seconds in, never resolves it, and then spends the ENTIRE remaining 5h47m with conflict markers in the state files - every bot dying on json.decoder.JSONDecodeError every cycle, 'set +e' swallowing all of it, and the job finally reporting SUCCESS having written nothing. Confirmed in 2 of 2 logs read (runs 31341480880 and 31317721748: 45-48 CONFLICTs, 29-48 JSON decode failures each). The runs alternate write/silent/write/silent, so real fleet uptime is about 50% of wall-clock, not the ~82% the workflow header claims. No corrupt state ever reached the repo - the poisoned runner cannot push - so this is an availability fault, not an integrity one. (2) THE GROK WATCHER IS OUT OF CREDITS. Verbatim from the same logs: xAI HTTP 403 'has either used all available credits or reached its monthly spending limit'. That is why sentinel_verdict.json has been frozen at 2026-08-07T10:47:38Z for 70.4 hours, and it is an account-level block rather than a runner problem because it also failed during today's healthy 08:35/08:49/09:02Z cycles. Fleet baseline is $9,000 across 9 active bots (stock/TQQQ retired 07-31; scholar and analyst added). Reported only, nothing touched.
